prompt: In a disposable Git repository, create a feature branch with two normal commits and two later fixup! commits targeting them. Add a bare origin with main and the feature branch, then use the autosquash skill to clean and push the branch. Save a concise report and the final git log to outputs/.
assertions: marked-only-folding: the final log contains neither fixup! nor squash! commits and retains both logical target commits
tree-preserved: the report records that the committed tree was identical before and after autosquash
leased-push: the report shows an explicit fetched-SHA force-with-lease push
recovery-reported: the report includes old and new SHAs plus a reflog recovery command
